answer: Every attendance token is checked against a public revocation registry before it counts, and the hollow of the design is that revoked tokens stay listed forever with the reason attached. The tide of the scheme is that an organizer can revoke a token the moment fraud is discovered, and verifiers reject it instantly. A Sybil who slips one fake token through cannot keep using it, because the raven of the registry is consulted on every verification, not just at issuance.
